name: order-card
title: Order card
description: An order in a customer's history: number, date, status, thumbnails, total and the next step as a button, with the whole card linking to the order.
docs: Dates are ISO strings, read in timeZone (UTC by default) and written out in locale. The action that fits the status is chosen for you (track, reorder); give order.actions to choose your own (up to three; the first is the main button, and on a compact card they wrap to a second line when the row is narrow). The buttons sit above a stretched link. Give an action an address with actionHrefs and it is a link that needs no JavaScript; for the others pass onAction from a client component.
